    for i in range(3):
        s.add(x[g][i] >= 0, x[g][i] <= 21)

# All distinct
all_vars = [x[g][i] for g in range(4) for i in range(3)]

# Between consecutive cliques
for g in range(3):
    for i in range(3):
        edges.append((x[g][i], x[g+1][i]))

print("Number of edges:", len(edges))

# For each edge, define absolute difference variable
abs_diffs = []
for idx, (u, v) in enumerate(edges):
    d = Int(f'd_{idx}')

    s.add(Or(And(u >= v, d == u - v), And(v > u, d == v - u)))
